title.raw: 卷十六 志第六 禮樂六 Volume 16 Treatises 6: Rites and Music 6

sentences.zh: 二曰賓禮，以待四夷之君長與其使者。

translations.literal: Second is guest rites, to receive the chieftains of the four quarters and their envoys.
translations.idiomatic: The second category is guest rites, for receiving the rulers of the four quarters and their envoys.

sentences.zh: 蕃國主來朝，遣使者迎勞，前一日，守宮設次於館門之外道右，南向。

translations.literal: When a barbarian-state lord comes to court, the court dispatches envoys to welcome and console him; on the day before, the Palace Keepers set a pavilion outside the hostel gate on the right of the road, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: When a foreign realm's lord comes to court, the court sends envoys to welcome and console him; the day before, the Palace Keepers set a pavilion outside the hostel gate on the right side of the road, facing south.

sentences.zh: 其日，使者就次，蕃主服其國服，立於東階下，西面。

translations.literal: On that day, the envoy takes his pavilion; the barbarian lord wears his national dress and stands below the east steps, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: On that day the envoy takes his pavilion; the foreign lord wears his national dress and stands below the east steps, facing west.

sentences.zh: 使者朝服出次，立於門西，東面；

translations.literal: The envoy in court dress leaves the pavilion and stands west of the gate, facing east;
translations.idiomatic: The envoy in court dress leaves the pavilion and stands west of the gate, facing east;

sentences.zh: 從者執束帛立於其南。

translations.literal: attendants holding bundled silks stand south of him.
translations.idiomatic: attendants holding bundled silks stand to his south.

sentences.zh: 有司出門，西面曰：「敢請事。

translations.literal: An officer goes out the gate, faces west, and says: "I venture to ask your business.
translations.idiomatic: An officer goes out the gate, faces west, and says: "I venture to ask your business.

sentences.zh: 」使者曰：「奉制勞某主。

translations.literal: " The envoy says: "By imperial command I console Lord So-and-so.
translations.idiomatic: " The envoy says: "By imperial command I console Lord So-and-so.

sentences.zh: 」稱其國名。

translations.literal: " naming his state.
translations.idiomatic: " naming his state.

sentences.zh: 有司入告，蕃主迎於門外之東，西面再拜，俱入。

translations.literal: An officer enters to report; the barbarian lord meets him east outside the gate, faces west and bows twice, and both enter.
translations.idiomatic: An officer enters to report; the foreign lord meets him east of the outer gate, faces west and bows twice, and both enter.

sentences.zh: 使者先升，立於西階上，執束帛者從升，立於其北，俱東向。

translations.literal: The envoy ascends first and stands on the west steps; those holding bundled silks follow up and stand north of him, all facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy ascends first and stands on the west steps; those holding bundled silks follow and stand north of him, all facing east.

sentences.zh: 蕃主乃升，立於東階上，西面。

translations.literal: The barbarian lord then ascends and stands on the east steps, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The foreign lord then ascends and stands on the east steps, facing west.

sentences.zh: 使者執幣曰：「有制。

translations.literal: The envoy holds the gift and says: "There is a command.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy holds the gift and says: "There is a command.

sentences.zh: 」蕃主將下拜，使者曰：「有後制，無下拜。

translations.literal: " The barbarian lord is about to descend to bow; the envoy says: "There is a further command: no descending bow.
translations.idiomatic: " The foreign lord is about to descend to bow; the envoy says: "There is a further command: do not descend to bow.

sentences.zh: 」蕃主旋，北面再拜稽首。

translations.literal: " The barbarian lord turns, faces north, and twice bows with forehead to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: " The foreign lord turns, faces north, and twice kowtows.

sentences.zh: 使者宣制，蕃主進受命，退復位，以幣授左右，又再拜稽首。

translations.literal: The envoy proclaims the command; the barbarian lord advances to receive the order, withdraws to his place, gives the gift to attendants at his side, and again twice bows with forehead to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy proclaims the command; the foreign lord advances to receive the order, withdraws to his place, hands the gift to attendants, and again kowtows twice.

sentences.zh: 使者降，出立於門外之西，東面。

translations.literal: The envoy descends and goes out to stand west outside the gate, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy descends and goes out to stand west of the outer gate, facing east.

sentences.zh: 蕃主送於門之外，西，止使者，揖以俱入，讓升，蕃主先升東階上，西面；

translations.literal: The barbarian lord escorts him outside the gate; west of it he stops the envoy, bows to enter together, yielding on the ascent—the barbarian lord first ascends the east steps, facing west;
translations.idiomatic: The foreign lord escorts him outside the gate; west of it he stops the envoy, bows them in together, yielding on the ascent—the foreign lord first ascends the east steps, facing west;

sentences.zh: 使者升西階上，東面。

translations.literal: the envoy ascends the west steps, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: the envoy ascends the west steps, facing east.

sentences.zh: 蕃主以土物儐使者，使者再拜受。

translations.literal: The barbarian lord entertains the envoy with local products; the envoy twice bows and receives.
translations.idiomatic: The foreign lord entertains the envoy with local products; the envoy bows twice and receives.

sentences.zh: 蕃主再拜送物，使者降，出，蕃主從出門外，皆如初。

translations.literal: The barbarian lord twice bows in sending the gifts; the envoy descends and goes out; the barbarian lord follows out the gate—all as at first.
translations.idiomatic: The foreign lord bows twice in sending the gifts; the envoy descends and goes out; the foreign lord follows out the gate—all as at first.

sentences.zh: 蕃主再拜送使者，還。

translations.literal: The barbarian lord twice bows in seeing off the envoy and returns.
translations.idiomatic: The foreign lord bows twice in seeing off the envoy and returns.

sentences.zh: 蕃主入，鴻臚迎引詣朝堂，依方北面立，所司奏聞，舍人承敕出，稱「有敕」。

translations.literal: The barbarian lord enters; the Grand Master of Ceremonies for Foreign Guests welcomes and leads him to the audience hall, where he stands facing north according to his quarter; the responsible office reports; the palace attendant receives the edict and goes out, saying "There is an edict."
translations.idiomatic: The foreign lord enters; the Grand Master of Ceremonies for Foreign Guests welcomes and leads him to the audience hall, where he stands facing north by his quarter; the responsible office reports; a palace attendant receives the edict and comes out, saying "There is an edict."

sentences.zh: 蕃主再拜。

translations.literal: The barbarian lord twice bows.
translations.idiomatic: The foreign lord bows twice.

sentences.zh: 宣勞，又再拜。

translations.literal: Consolation is proclaimed; he again twice bows.
translations.idiomatic: Consolation is proclaimed; he bows twice again.

sentences.zh: 乃就館。

translations.literal: He then goes to the hostel.
translations.idiomatic: He then goes to the hostel.

sentences.zh: 皇帝遣使戒蕃主見日，如勞禮。

translations.literal: The emperor dispatches an envoy to inform the barbarian lord of the audience day, as in the consolation rite.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor dispatches an envoy to inform the foreign lord of the audience day, as in the consolation rite.

sentences.zh: 宣制曰：「某日，某主見。

translations.literal: The command is proclaimed: "On such-and-such a day, Lord So-and-so shall have audience.
translations.idiomatic: The command is proclaimed: "On such-and-such a day, Lord So-and-so shall have audience.

sentences.zh: 」蕃主拜稽首。

translations.literal: " The barbarian lord bows with forehead to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: " The foreign lord kowtows.

sentences.zh: 使者降，出，蕃主送。

translations.literal: The envoy descends and goes out; the barbarian lord sees him off.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy descends and goes out; the foreign lord sees him off.

sentences.zh: 蕃主奉見。

translations.literal: The barbarian lord presents himself for audience.
translations.idiomatic: The foreign lord presents himself for audience.

sentences.zh: 前一日，尚舍奉御設御幄於太極殿，南向；

translations.literal: On the day before, the Palace Provisioners set the imperial canopy in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate, facing south;
translations.idiomatic: On the day before, the Palace Provisioners set the imperial canopy in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate, facing south;

sentences.zh: 蕃主坐於西南，東向。

translations.literal: the barbarian lord sits in the southwest, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: the foreign lord sits in the southwest, facing east.

sentences.zh: 守宮設次，太樂令展宮縣，設舉麾位於上下，鼓吹令設十二桉，乘黃令陳車輅，尚輦奉御陳輿輦。

translations.literal: The Palace Keepers set the pavilion; the Director of Imperial Music deploys the palace bells; positions for raising batons are set above and below; the Director of Court Music sets twelve music stands; the Director of the Imperial Stud displays chariots; the Palace Carriage Attendants display litters.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Keepers set the pavilion; the Director of Imperial Music deploys the palace bells; positions for raising batons are set above and below; the Director of Court Music sets twelve music stands; the Director of the Imperial Stud displays chariots; the Palace Carriage Attendants display litters.

sentences.zh: 典儀設蕃主立位於縣南道西，北面；

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies sets the barbarian lord's standing place south of the bells on the west of the road, facing north;
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies sets the foreign lord's standing place south of the bells on the west side of the road, facing north;

sentences.zh: 蕃國諸官之位於其後，重行，北面西上，典儀位于縣之東北，贊者二人在南，差退，俱西面。

translations.literal: places for the barbarian state's officials behind him in double ranks, facing north with the west uppermost; the Director of Ceremonies stands northeast of the bells; two announcers south of him, somewhat withdrawn, all facing west.
translations.idiomatic: places for the foreign state's officials behind him in double ranks, facing north with the west uppermost; the Director of Ceremonies stands northeast of the bells; two announcers south of him, somewhat withdrawn, all facing west.

sentences.zh: 諸衞各勒部，屯門列黃麾仗。

translations.literal: Each guard command assembles its section and arrays yellow-banner guards at the gates.
translations.idiomatic: Each guard command assembles its section and arrays yellow-banner guards at the gates.

sentences.zh: 所司迎引蕃主至承天門外，就次。

translations.literal: The responsible office welcomes and leads the barbarian lord to outside the Gate of Accepting Heaven and he takes his pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible office welcomes and leads the foreign lord to outside the Gate of Accepting Heaven and he takes his pavilion.

sentences.zh: 本司入奏，鈒戟近仗皆入。

translations.literal: His office enters to report; halberd guards and close attendants all enter.
translations.idiomatic: His office enters to report; halberd guards and close attendants all enter.

sentences.zh: 典儀帥贊者先入，就位。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies leads the announcers in first and takes their places.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies leads the announcers in first and takes their places.

sentences.zh: 侍中版奏「請中嚴」。

translations.literal: The attendant within the palace memorializes on the placard: "I request inner vigilance."
translations.idiomatic: The palace attendant memorializes on the placard: "I request inner vigilance."

sentences.zh: 諸侍衞之官及符寶郎詣閤奉迎，蕃主及其屬各立於閤外西廂，東面。

translations.literal: Officers of the inner guard and the seal-and-talisman attendant go to the side hall to welcome; the barbarian lord and his retinue each stand in the west wing outside the hall, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: Officers of the inner guard and the seal-and-talisman attendant go to the side hall to welcome; the foreign lord and his retinue each stand in the west wing outside the hall, facing east.

sentences.zh: 侍中版奏「外辦」。

translations.literal: The attendant within the palace memorializes on the placard: "The outer preparations are complete."
translations.idiomatic: The palace attendant memorializes on the placard: "The outer preparations are complete."

sentences.zh: 皇帝服通天冠、絳紗袍，乘輿以出。

translations.literal: The emperor wears the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe and goes out in the imperial litter.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wears the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe and goes out in the imperial litter.

sentences.zh: 舍人引蕃主入門，舒和之樂作。

translations.literal: A palace attendant leads the barbarian lord through the gate; the music Shuhe begins.
translations.idiomatic: A palace attendant leads the foreign lord through the gate; the music Shuhe begins.

sentences.zh: 典儀曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies says: "Bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies says: "Bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」蕃主再拜稽首。

translations.literal: " The barbarian lord twice bows with forehead to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: " The foreign lord kowtows twice.

sentences.zh: 侍中承制降詣蕃主西北，東面曰：「有制。

translations.literal: The attendant within the palace receives the command, descends to the barbarian lord's northwest, faces east, and says: "There is a command.
translations.idiomatic: The palace attendant receives the command, descends to the foreign lord's northwest, faces east, and says: "There is a command.

sentences.zh: 」蕃主再拜稽首。

translations.literal: " The barbarian lord twice bows with forehead to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: " The foreign lord kowtows twice.

sentences.zh: 乃宣制，又再拜稽首。

translations.literal: He then proclaims the command; again twice bows with forehead to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: He then proclaims the command; the foreign lord again kowtows twice.

sentences.zh: 侍中還奏，承制降勞，敕升座。

translations.literal: The attendant within the palace returns to report; receives the command to descend and console, and orders him to ascend the seat.
translations.idiomatic: The palace attendant returns to report; receives the command to descend and console, and orders him to ascend the seat.

sentences.zh: 蕃主再拜稽首，升座。

translations.literal: The barbarian lord twice bows with forehead to the ground and ascends the seat.
translations.idiomatic: The foreign lord kowtows twice and ascends the seat.

sentences.zh: 侍中承制勞問，蕃主俛伏避席，將下拜，侍中承制曰：「無下拜。

translations.literal: The attendant within the palace receives the command to inquire after him in consolation; the barbarian lord bows low and leaves his mat, about to descend to bow; the attendant within the palace receives the command: "No descending bow.
translations.idiomatic: The palace attendant receives the command to inquire after him in consolation; the foreign lord bows low and leaves his mat, about to descend to bow; the palace attendant receives the command: "Do not descend to bow.

sentences.zh: 」蕃主復位，拜而對。

translations.literal: " The barbarian lord returns to his place, bows, and replies.
translations.idiomatic: " The foreign lord returns to his place, bows, and replies.

sentences.zh: 侍中還奏，承制勞還館。

translations.literal: The attendant within the palace returns to report; receives the command to console him on returning to the hostel.
translations.idiomatic: The palace attendant returns to report; receives the command to console him on returning to the hostel.

sentences.zh: 蕃主降，復縣南位，再拜稽首。

translations.literal: The barbarian lord descends, returns to his place south of the bells, and twice bows with forehead to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: The foreign lord descends, returns to his place south of the bells, and kowtows twice.

sentences.zh: 其官屬勞以舍人，與其主俱出。

translations.literal: His officials are consoled by palace attendants and go out together with their lord.
translations.idiomatic: His officials are consoled by palace attendants and go out together with their lord.

sentences.zh: 侍中奏「禮畢」。

translations.literal: The attendant within the palace reports: "The rite is complete."
translations.idiomatic: The palace attendant reports: "The rite is complete."

sentences.zh: 皇帝興。

translations.literal: The emperor rises.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rises.

sentences.zh: 若蕃國遣使奉表幣，其勞及戒見皆如蕃國主。

translations.literal: If a barbarian state sends envoys presenting a memorial and gifts, the consolation and audience notification are as for a barbarian-state lord.
translations.idiomatic: If a foreign state sends envoys presenting a memorial and gifts, the consolation and audience notification are as for a foreign lord.

sentences.zh: 庭實陳於客前，中書侍郎受表置於案，至西階以表升。

translations.literal: Court offerings are displayed before the guest; the vice president of the Secretariat receives the memorial and places it on the desk, and ascends the west steps with the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Court offerings are displayed before the guest; the vice president of the Secretariat receives the memorial and places it on the desk, and ascends the west steps with the memorial.

sentences.zh: 有司各率其屬受其幣焉。

translations.literal: The responsible officers each lead their subordinates to receive the gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officers each lead their subordinates to receive the gifts.

sentences.zh: 其宴蕃國主及其使，皆如見禮。

translations.literal: Banquets for the barbarian-state lord and his envoys all follow the audience rite.
translations.idiomatic: Banquets for the foreign lord and his envoys all follow the audience rite.

sentences.zh: 皇帝已即御坐，蕃主入，其有獻物陳於其前。

translations.literal: When the emperor has already taken the imperial seat, the barbarian lord enters; if there are tribute items they are displayed before him.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor has already taken the imperial seat, the foreign lord enters; if there are tribute items they are displayed before him.

sentences.zh: 侍中承制降敕，蕃主升座。

translations.literal: The attendant within the palace receives the command to descend with an edict; the barbarian lord ascends the seat.
translations.idiomatic: The palace attendant receives the command to descend with an edict; the foreign lord ascends the seat.

sentences.zh: 蕃主再拜奉贄，曰：「某國蕃臣某敢獻壤奠。

translations.literal: The barbarian lord twice bows and presents the tribute, saying: "The barbarian subject So-and-so of Such-and-such a state ventures to present the soil offering.
translations.idiomatic: The foreign lord bows twice and presents the tribute, saying: "The barbarian subject So-and-so of Such-and-such a state ventures to present the soil offering.

sentences.zh: 」侍中升奏，承旨曰：「朕其受之。

translations.literal: " The attendant within the palace ascends to report; receives the imperial intent: "We shall receive it.
translations.idiomatic: " The palace attendant ascends to report; receives the imperial intent: "We shall receive it.

sentences.zh: 」侍中降於蕃主東北，西面，稱「有制」。

translations.literal: " The attendant within the palace descends northeast of the barbarian lord, faces west, and says "There is a command."
translations.idiomatic: " The palace attendant descends northeast of the foreign lord, faces west, and says "There is a command."

sentences.zh: 蕃主再拜，乃宣制。

translations.literal: The barbarian lord twice bows; he then proclaims the command.
translations.idiomatic: The foreign lord bows twice; he then proclaims the command.

sentences.zh: 又再拜以贄授侍中，以授有司。

translations.literal: Again twice bows and gives the tribute to the attendant within the palace, who gives it to the responsible officers.
translations.idiomatic: He bows twice again and gives the tribute to the palace attendant, who passes it to the responsible officers.

sentences.zh: 有司受其餘幣，俱以東。

translations.literal: The responsible officers receive the remaining gifts, all to the east.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officers receive the remaining gifts, all to the east.

sentences.zh: 舍人承旨降敕就座，蕃國諸官俱再拜。

translations.literal: A palace attendant receives the imperial intent, descends with an edict to be seated; all officials of the barbarian state twice bow.
translations.idiomatic: A palace attendant receives the imperial intent, descends with an edict to be seated; all officials of the foreign state bow twice.

sentences.zh: 應升殿者自西階，其不升殿者分別立於廊下席後。

translations.literal: Those who should ascend the hall do so by the west steps; those who do not ascend the hall stand separately behind the seats in the corridor.
translations.idiomatic: Those who should ascend the hall do so by the west steps; those who do not ascend stand separately behind the seats in the corridor.

sentences.zh: 典儀曰：「就坐。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies says: "Be seated.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies says: "Be seated.

sentences.zh: 」階下贊者承傳，皆就座。

translations.literal: " Announcers below the steps transmit; all are seated.
translations.idiomatic: " Announcers below the steps transmit; all are seated.

sentences.zh: 太樂令引歌者及琴瑟至階，脫履，升坐，其笙管者，就階間北面立。

translations.literal: The Director of Imperial Music leads singers and zithers to the steps; they remove shoes, ascend and sit; those with pipes and flutes stand between the steps, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Imperial Music leads singers and zithers to the steps; they remove shoes, ascend and sit; those with pipes and flutes stand between the steps, facing north.

sentences.zh: 尚食奉御進酒，至階，典儀曰：「酒至，興。

translations.literal: The Imperial Food Attendant advances wine to the steps; the Director of Ceremonies says: "Wine has arrived—rise.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Food Attendant advances wine to the steps; the Director of Ceremonies says: "Wine has arrived—rise.

sentences.zh: 」階下贊者承傳，皆俛伏，興，立。

translations.literal: " Announcers below the steps transmit; all bow low, rise, and stand.
translations.idiomatic: " Announcers below the steps transmit; all bow low, rise, and stand.

sentences.zh: 殿中監及階省酒，尚食奉御進酒，皇帝舉酒，良醞令行酒。

translations.literal: The palace-inside supervisor and step supervisors inspect the wine; the Imperial Food Attendant advances wine; the emperor raises his cup; the Director of Fine Wine serves wine.
translations.idiomatic: The palace-inside supervisor and step supervisors inspect the wine; the Imperial Food Attendant advances wine; the emperor raises his cup; the Director of Fine Wine serves wine.

sentences.zh: 典儀曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies says: "Bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies says: "Bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」階下贊者承傳，皆再拜，受觶。

translations.literal: " Announcers below the steps transmit; all twice bow and receive the goblet.
translations.idiomatic: " Announcers below the steps transmit; all bow twice and receive the goblet.

sentences.zh: 皇帝初舉酒，登歌作昭和三終。

translations.literal: When the emperor first raises wine, the elevated singers perform Zhaohu in three endings.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor first raises wine, the elevated singers perform Zhaohu in three endings.

sentences.zh: 尚食奉御受虛觶，奠于坫。

translations.literal: The Imperial Food Attendant receives the empty goblet and places it on the altar.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Food Attendant receives the empty goblet and places it on the altar.

sentences.zh: 酒三行，尚食奉御進食，典儀曰：「食至，興。

translations.literal: After three rounds of wine, the Imperial Food Attendant advances food; the Director of Ceremonies says: "Food has arrived—rise.
translations.idiomatic: After three rounds of wine, the Imperial Food Attendant advances food; the Director of Ceremonies says: "Food has arrived—rise.

sentences.zh: 」階下贊者承傳，皆興，立。

translations.literal: " Announcers below the steps transmit; all rise and stand.
translations.idiomatic: " Announcers below the steps transmit; all rise and stand.

sentences.zh: 殿中監及階省桉，尚食奉御品嘗食，以次進，太官令行蕃主以下食桉。

translations.literal: The palace-inside supervisor and step supervisors inspect the trays; the Imperial Food Attendant tastes the food and advances it in order; the Director of the Imperial Kitchen serves food trays to the barbarian lord and those below.
translations.idiomatic: The palace-inside supervisor and step supervisors inspect the trays; the Imperial Food Attendant tastes the food and advances it in order; the Director of the Imperial Kitchen serves food trays to the foreign lord and those below.

sentences.zh: 典儀曰：「就坐。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies says: "Be seated.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies says: "Be seated.

sentences.zh: 」階下贊者承傳，皆就坐。

translations.literal: " Announcers below the steps transmit; all are seated.
translations.idiomatic: " Announcers below the steps transmit; all are seated.

sentences.zh: 皇帝乃飯，蕃主以下皆飯。

translations.literal: The emperor then eats; the barbarian lord and those below all eat.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then eats; the foreign lord and those below all eat.

sentences.zh: 徹桉，又行酒，遂設庶羞。

translations.literal: Trays are cleared; wine is served again; then assorted delicacies are set out.
translations.idiomatic: Trays are cleared; wine is served again; then assorted delicacies are set out.

sentences.zh: 二舞以次入，作。

translations.literal: The two dances enter in turn and perform.
translations.idiomatic: The two dances enter in turn and perform.

sentences.zh: 食畢，蕃主以下復位于縣南，皆再拜。

translations.literal: When the meal is finished, the barbarian lord and those below return to their places south of the bells and all twice bow.
translations.idiomatic: When the meal is finished, the foreign lord and those below return to their places south of the bells and all bow twice.

sentences.zh: 若有筐篚，舍人前承旨降宣敕，蕃主以下又再拜，乃出。

translations.literal: If there are baskets of gifts, a palace attendant advances before them, receives the imperial intent, descends to proclaim the edict; the barbarian lord and those below again twice bow and then go out.
translations.idiomatic: If there are baskets of gifts, a palace attendant advances before them, receives the imperial intent, descends to proclaim the edict; the foreign lord and those below bow twice again and then go out.

sentences.zh: 其三曰軍禮。

translations.literal: Third is military rites.
translations.idiomatic: The third category is military rites.

sentences.zh: 皇帝親征。

translations.literal: The emperor personally campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally campaigns.

sentences.zh: 纂嚴。

translations.literal: Gathering strictness.
translations.idiomatic: Gathering strictness.

sentences.zh: 前期一日，有司設御幄於太極殿，南向。

translations.literal: One day in advance, the responsible officers set the imperial canopy in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: One day in advance, the responsible officers set the imperial canopy in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate, facing south.

sentences.zh: 文武羣官次於殿庭東西，每等異位，重行北向。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials take their places in the east and west of the hall courtyard, each rank in a separate place, double ranks facing north.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials take their places in the east and west of the hall courtyard, each rank in a separate place, double ranks facing north.

sentences.zh: 乘黃令陳革輅以下車旗于庭。

translations.literal: The Director of the Imperial Stud displays the leather chariot and the chariots and banners below it in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Imperial Stud displays the leather chariot and the chariots and banners below it in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 其日未明，諸衞勒所部，列黃麾仗。

translations.literal: Before dawn that day, each guard command assembles its section and arrays yellow-banner guards.
translations.idiomatic: Before dawn that day, each guard command assembles its section and arrays yellow-banner guards.

sentences.zh: 平明，侍臣、將帥、從行之官皆平巾幘、袴褶。

translations.literal: At daybreak, attendant ministers, generals, and officials accompanying the march all wear plain headcloths and trousers with jacket.
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak, attendant ministers, generals, and officials accompanying the march all wear plain headcloths and trousers with jacket.

sentences.zh: 留守之官公服，就次。

translations.literal: Officials remaining on guard wear court dress and take their places.
translations.idiomatic: Officials remaining on guard wear court dress and take their places.

sentences.zh: 上水五刻，侍中版奏「請中嚴」。

translations.literal: At the fifth quarter after the water clock's upper mark, the attendant within the palace memorializes on the placard: "I request inner vigilance."
translations.idiomatic: At the fifth quarter after the water clock's upper mark, the palace attendant memorializes on the placard: "I request inner vigilance."

sentences.zh: 鈒戟近仗列于庭。

translations.literal: Halberd guards and close attendants line up in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Halberd guards and close attendants line up in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 三刻，羣官就位，諸侍臣詣閤奉迎。

translations.literal: At the third quarter, the assembled officials take their places; attendant ministers go to the side hall to welcome.
translations.idiomatic: At the third quarter, the assembled officials take their places; attendant ministers go to the side hall to welcome.

sentences.zh: 侍中版奏「外辦」。

translations.literal: The attendant within the palace memorializes on the placard: "The outer preparations are complete."
translations.idiomatic: The palace attendant memorializes on the placard: "The outer preparations are complete."

sentences.zh: 皇帝服武弁，御輿以出，即御座。

translations.literal: The emperor wears the military cap, mounts the carriage, goes out, and takes the imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wears the military cap, mounts the carriage, goes out, and takes the imperial seat.

sentences.zh: 典儀曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The Director of Ceremonies says: "Bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ceremonies says: "Bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」在位者皆再拜。

translations.literal: " Those in place all twice bow.
translations.idiomatic: " Those in place all bow twice.

sentences.zh: 中書令承旨敕百寮羣官出，侍中跪奏「禮畢」。

translations.literal: The president of the Secretariat receives the imperial intent and orders the hundred officials and assembled officers out; the attendant within the palace kneels and reports: "The rite is complete."
translations.idiomatic: The president of the Secretariat receives the imperial intent and orders the hundred officials and assembled officers out; the palace attendant kneels and reports: "The rite is complete."

sentences.zh: 皇帝入自東房，侍臣從至閤。

translations.literal: The emperor enters from the east chamber; attendant ministers follow to the side hall.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor enters from the east chamber; attendant ministers follow to the side hall.

sentences.zh: 乃禷于昊天上帝。

translations.literal: He then offers to the August Supreme God of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: He then offers to the August Supreme God of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 前一日，皇帝清齊於太極殿，諸豫告之官、侍臣、軍將與在位者皆清齊一日。

translations.literal: On the day before, the emperor keeps pure abstinence in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate; all officials to be notified, attendant ministers, military officers, and those in place all keep pure abstinence one day.
translations.idiomatic: On the day before, the emperor keeps pure abstinence in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate; all officials to be notified, attendant ministers, military officers, and those in place all keep pure abstinence one day.

sentences.zh: 其日，皇帝服武弁，乘革輅，備大駕，至于壇所。

translations.literal: On that day the emperor wears the military cap, rides the leather chariot with full imperial escort, and arrives at the altar site.
translations.idiomatic: On that day the emperor wears the military cap, rides the leather chariot with full imperial escort, and arrives at the altar site.

sentences.zh: 其牲二及玉幣皆以蒼。

translations.literal: The victims are two and the jade and silks all azure.
translations.idiomatic: The victims are two and the jade and silks all azure.

sentences.zh: 尊以太尊、山罍各二，其獻一。

translations.literal: Vessels: two Grand Vessels and two mountain urns each; one offering.
translations.idiomatic: Vessels: two Grand Vessels and two mountain urns each; one offering.

sentences.zh: 皇帝已飲福，諸軍將升自東階，立于神座前，北向西上，飲福受胙。

translations.literal: After the emperor has drunk the blessing, the military generals ascend by the east steps, stand before the spirit seat, face north with the west uppermost, drink the blessing, and receive the sacrificial flesh.
translations.idiomatic: After the emperor has drunk the blessing, the military generals ascend by the east steps, stand before the spirit seat, face north with the west uppermost, drink the blessing, and receive the sacrificial flesh.

sentences.zh: 將軍之次在外壝南門之外道東，西向北上。

translations.literal: The generals' places are outside the outer enclosure's south gate on the east of the road, facing west with the north uppermost.
translations.idiomatic: The generals' places are outside the outer enclosure's south gate on the east of the road, facing west with the north uppermost.

sentences.zh: 其即事之位在縣南，北面。

translations.literal: Their places for performing the rite are south of the bells, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: Their places for performing the rite are south of the bells, facing north.

sentences.zh: 每等異位，重行西上。

translations.literal: Each rank in a separate place, double ranks with the west uppermost.
translations.idiomatic: Each rank in a separate place, double ranks with the west uppermost.

sentences.zh: 其奠玉帛、進熟、飲福、望燎，皆如南郊。

translations.literal: Presenting jade and silks, advancing the cooked offering, drinking the blessing, and gazing at the burning—all as at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting jade and silks, advancing the cooked offering, drinking the blessing, and gazing at the burning—all as at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 其宜于社，造于廟，皆各如其禮而一獻。

translations.literal: Appropriate offerings at the altars of soil and grain and at the ancestral temple each follow its own rite with one offering.
translations.idiomatic: Appropriate offerings at the altars of soil and grain and at the ancestral temple each follow its own rite with one offering.

sentences.zh: 軍將飲福于太稷，廟則皇考之室。

translations.literal: Military generals drink the blessing at the Grand Altar of Grain; at the temple, in the hall of the imperial father.
translations.idiomatic: Military generals drink the blessing at the Grand Altar of Grain; at the temple, in the hall of the imperial father.

sentences.zh: 其凱旋，則陳俘馘於廟南門之外，軍實陳于其後。

translations.literal: On triumphant return, captives and severed ears are displayed outside the temple's south gate; military booty is displayed behind them.
translations.idiomatic: On triumphant return, captives and severed ears are displayed outside the temple's south gate; military booty is displayed behind them.

sentences.zh: 其解嚴，皇帝服通天冠、絳紗袍，羣臣再拜以退，而無所詔。

translations.literal: On disbanding strictness, the emperor wears the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe; the assembled officials twice bow and withdraw, with no proclamation.
translations.idiomatic: On disbanding strictness, the emperor wears the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe; the assembled officials bow twice and withdraw, with no proclamation.

sentences.zh: 其餘皆如纂嚴。

translations.literal: The rest are all as in gathering strictness.
translations.idiomatic: The rest are all as in gathering strictness.

sentences.zh: 若禡于所征之地，則為壝再重，以熊席祀軒轅氏。

translations.literal: If offering prayers at the place of campaign, a double enclosure is made and the Yellow Thearch is sacrificed on bear skins.
translations.idiomatic: If offering prayers at the place of campaign, a double enclosure is made and the Yellow Thearch is sacrificed on bear skins.

sentences.zh: 兵部建兩旗于外壝南門之外，陳甲冑、弓矢于神位之側，植矟于其後。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War erects two banners outside the outer enclosure's south gate; armor, bows, and arrows are displayed beside the spirit seat; spears are planted behind.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War erects two banners outside the outer enclosure's south gate; armor, bows, and arrows are displayed beside the spirit seat; spears are planted behind.

sentences.zh: 尊以犧、象、山罍各二，饌以特牲。

translations.literal: Vessels: two sacrificial, two elephant, and two mountain urns each; offerings are single victims.
translations.idiomatic: Vessels: two sacrificial, two elephant, and two mountain urns each; offerings are single victims.

sentences.zh: 皇帝服武弁，羣臣戎服，三獻。

translations.literal: The emperor wears the military cap; the assembled officials wear military dress; three offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wears the military cap; the assembled officials wear military dress; three offerings.

sentences.zh: 其接於神者皆如常祀，瘞而不燎。

translations.literal: Those who communicate with the spirits are as in regular sacrifices; buried in the pit without burning.
translations.idiomatic: Those who communicate with the spirits are as in regular sacrifices; buried in the pit without burning.

sentences.zh: 其軍將之位如禷。

translations.literal: The places of military generals are as in the prayer offering.
translations.idiomatic: The places of military generals are as in the prayer offering.

sentences.zh: 其軷于國門，右校委土於國門外為軷，又為瘞埳於神位西北，太祝布神位於軷前，南向。

translations.literal: The road-blessing at the state gate: the Right Works Office piles earth outside the state gate as the road-blessing; a burial pit is also made northwest of the spirit seat; the Grand Invoker sets the spirit seat before the road-blessing, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The road-blessing at the state gate: the Right Works Office piles earth outside the state gate as the road-blessing; a burial pit is also made northwest of the spirit seat; the Grand Invoker sets the spirit seat before the road-blessing, facing south.

sentences.zh: 太官令帥宰人刳羊。

translations.literal: The Director of the Imperial Kitchen leads butchers to flay the sheep.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Imperial Kitchen leads butchers to flay the sheep.

sentences.zh: 郊社之屬設尊、罍、篚、冪於神左，俱右向；

translations.literal: Subordinates of the suburban and altar offices set vessels, urns, baskets, and covers to the spirit's left, all facing right;
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates of the suburban and altar offices set vessels, urns, baskets, and covers to the spirit's left, all facing right;

sentences.zh: 置幣於尊所。

translations.literal: silks are placed where the vessels stand.
translations.idiomatic: silks are placed where the vessels stand.

sentences.zh: 皇帝將至，太祝立於罍、洗東南，西向再拜，取幣進，跪奠於神。

translations.literal: When the emperor is about to arrive, the Grand Invoker stands southeast of the urn washing-stand, faces west and bows twice, takes the silks and advances, kneels, and places them before the spirit.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor is about to arrive, the Grand Invoker stands southeast of the urn washing-stand, faces west and bows twice, takes the silks and advances, kneels, and places them before the spirit.

sentences.zh: 進饌者薦脯醢，加羊於軷西首。

translations.literal: Those advancing offerings present dried meat and pickled sauce and add the sheep west of the road-blessing with its head to the west.
translations.idiomatic: Those advancing offerings present dried meat and pickled sauce and add the sheep west of the road-blessing with its head to the west.

sentences.zh: 太祝盥手洗爵，酌酒進，跪奠於神，興，少退，北向立，讀祝。

translations.literal: The Grand Invoker washes his hands, washes the goblet, pours wine and advances, kneels and places it before the spirit, rises, withdraws slightly, stands facing north, and reads the prayer.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Invoker washes his hands, washes the goblet, pours wine and advances, kneels and places it before the spirit, rises, withdraws slightly, stands facing north, and reads the prayer.

sentences.zh: 太祝再拜。

translations.literal: The Grand Invoker twice bows.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Invoker bows twice.

sentences.zh: 少頃，帥齋郎奉幣、爵、酒饌，宰人舉羊肆解之，太祝幷載，埋於埳。

translations.literal: Shortly after, he leads the abstinence attendants bearing silks, goblets, wine, and offerings; the butchers lift the sheep, dismember it, and the Grand Invoker loads everything and buries it in the pit.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly after, he leads the abstinence attendants bearing silks, goblets, wine, and offerings; the butchers lift the sheep, dismember it, and the Grand Invoker loads everything and buries it in the pit.

sentences.zh: 執尊者徹罍、篚、席，駕至，權停。

translations.literal: Those holding the vessels remove the urns, baskets, and mats; when the carriage arrives, it pauses briefly.
translations.idiomatic: Those holding the vessels remove the urns, baskets, and mats; when the carriage arrives, it pauses briefly.

sentences.zh: 太祝以爵酌酒，授太僕卿，左併轡，右受酒，祭兩軹及軌前，乃飲，授爵，駕轢軷而行。

translations.literal: The Grand Invoker pours wine from the goblet, gives it to the Grand Master of the Imperial Stud, who with his left hand holds the reins together and with his right receives the wine, sacrifices to both wheel hubs and before the axle, then drinks, gives back the goblet, and the carriage rolls over the road-blessing and proceeds.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Invoker pours wine from the goblet, gives it to the Grand Master of the Imperial Stud, who with his left hand holds the reins together and with his right receives the wine, sacrifices to both wheel hubs and before the axle, then drinks, gives back the goblet, and the carriage rolls over the road-blessing and proceeds.

sentences.zh: 其所過山川，遣官告，以一獻。

translations.literal: For mountains and rivers passed, officers are dispatched to announce with one offering.
translations.idiomatic: For mountains and rivers passed, officers are dispatched to announce with one offering.

sentences.zh: 若遣將出征，則皆有司行事。

translations.literal: If a general is dispatched on campaign, the responsible offices perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: If a general is dispatched on campaign, the responsible offices perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 賊平而宣露布。

translations.literal: When rebels are pacified, the victory bulletin is proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels are pacified, the victory bulletin is proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 其日，守宮量設羣官次。

translations.literal: On that day the Palace Keepers measure and set the officials' places.
translations.idiomatic: On that day the Palace Keepers measure and set the officials' places.

sentences.zh: 露布至，兵部侍郎奉以奏聞，承制集文武羣官、客使於東朝堂，各服其服。

translations.literal: When the victory bulletin arrives, the vice minister of war presents it to report; by imperial command the civil and military officials and envoys are assembled in the eastern audience hall, each in his proper dress.
translations.idiomatic: When the victory bulletin arrives, the vice minister of war presents it to report; by imperial command the civil and military officials and envoys are assembled in the eastern audience hall, each in his proper dress.

sentences.zh: 奉禮設版位於其前，近南，文東武西，重行北向。

translations.literal: The Director of Ritual sets placards before them, near the south; civil east, military west, double ranks facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Ritual sets placards before them, near the south; civil east, military west, double ranks facing north.

sentences.zh: 又設客使之位。

translations.literal: Places for envoys are also set.
translations.idiomatic: Places for envoys are also set.

sentences.zh: 設中書令位於羣官之北，南面。

translations.literal: The president of the Secretariat's place is north of the assembled officials, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The president of the Secretariat's place is north of the assembled officials, facing south.

sentences.zh: 吏部、兵部贊羣官、客使，謁者引就位。

translations.literal: The ministries of civil and military personnel announce the assembled officials and envoys; ushers lead them to their places.
translations.idiomatic: The ministries of civil and military personnel announce the assembled officials and envoys; ushers lead them to their places.

sentences.zh: 中書令受露布置於桉。

translations.literal: The president of the Secretariat receives the victory bulletin and places it on the desk.
translations.idiomatic: The president of the Secretariat receives the victory bulletin and places it on the desk.

sentences.zh: 令史二人絳公服，對舉之以從。

translations.literal: Two clerks in crimson court dress raise it together and follow.
translations.idiomatic: Two clerks in crimson court dress raise it together and follow.

sentences.zh: 中書令出，就南面位，持桉者立於西南，東面。

translations.literal: The president of the Secretariat goes out, takes the south-facing place; those holding the desk stand southwest, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The president of the Secretariat goes out, takes the south-facing place; those holding the desk stand southwest, facing east.

sentences.zh: 中書令取露布，稱「有制」。

translations.literal: The president of the Secretariat takes the victory bulletin and says "There is a command."
translations.idiomatic: The president of the Secretariat takes the victory bulletin and says "There is a command."

sentences.zh: 羣官、客使皆再拜。

translations.literal: The assembled officials and envoys all twice bow.
translations.idiomatic: The assembled officials and envoys all bow twice.

sentences.zh: 遂宣之，又再拜，舞蹈，又再拜。

translations.literal: He then proclaims it; again twice bow, dance, and again twice bow.
translations.idiomatic: He then proclaims it; they bow twice again, dance, and bow twice again.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書進受露布，退復位，兵部侍郎前受之。

translations.literal: The minister of war advances to receive the victory bulletin, withdraws to his place; the vice minister of war steps forward to receive it.
translations.idiomatic: The minister of war advances to receive the victory bulletin, withdraws to his place; the vice minister of war steps forward to receive it.

sentences.zh: 中書令入，羣官、客使各還次。

translations.literal: The president of the Secretariat enters; the assembled officials and envoys each return to their places.
translations.idiomatic: The president of the Secretariat enters; the assembled officials and envoys each return to their places.

sentences.zh: 仲冬之月，講武於都外。

translations.literal: In the mid-winter month, military exercises are held outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the mid-winter month, military exercises are held outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 前期十有一日，所司奏請講武。

translations.literal: Eleven days in advance, the responsible office memorializes requesting the exercise.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven days in advance, the responsible office memorializes requesting the exercise.

sentences.zh: 兵部承詔，遂命將帥簡軍士，除地為場，方一千二百步，四出為和門。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War receives the edict and orders generals to select soldiers, clear ground for a field twelve hundred paces square, with four harmonizing gates.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War receives the edict and orders generals to select soldiers, clear ground for a field twelve hundred paces square, with four harmonizing gates.

sentences.zh: 又為步、騎六軍營域，左右廂各為三軍，北上。

translations.literal: Camp domains are also laid out for six armies of infantry and cavalry; left and right wings each have three armies, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: Camp domains are also laid out for six armies of infantry and cavalry; left and right wings each have three armies, facing north.

sentences.zh: 中間相去三百步，立五表，表間五十步，為二軍進止之節。

translations.literal: Three hundred paces apart in the middle, five markers are set, fifty paces between markers, as signals for the two armies' advance and halt.
translations.idiomatic: Three hundred paces apart in the middle, five markers are set, fifty paces between markers, as signals for the two armies' advance and halt.

sentences.zh: 別墠地於北廂，南向。

translations.literal: A separate earthen platform is made in the north wing, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: A separate earthen platform is made in the north wing, facing south.

sentences.zh: 前三日，尚舍奉御設大次於墠。

translations.literal: Three days before, the Palace Provisioners set the great pavilion on the platform.
translations.idiomatic: Three days before, the Palace Provisioners set the great pavilion on the platform.

sentences.zh: 前一日，講武將帥及士卒集於墠所，建旗為和門，如方色。

translations.literal: On the day before, exercise generals and soldiers assemble at the platform; flags are raised as harmonizing gates according to the quarter's color.
translations.idiomatic: On the day before, exercise generals and soldiers assemble at the platform; flags are raised as harmonizing gates according to the quarter's color.

sentences.zh: 都墠之中及四角皆建五采牙旗、旗鼓甲仗。

translations.literal: In the center of the platform and at the four corners are set five-colored pennant flags, drums, banners, armor, and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: In the center of the platform and at the four corners are set five-colored pennant flags, drums, banners, armor, and weapons.

sentences.zh: 大將以下，各有統帥。

translations.literal: Below the great general, each has a commander.
translations.idiomatic: Below the great general, each has a commander.

sentences.zh: 大將被甲乘馬，教習士眾。

translations.literal: The great general dons armor, mounts a horse, and drills the troops.
translations.idiomatic: The great general dons armor, mounts a horse, and drills the troops.

sentences.zh: 少者在前，長者在後。

translations.literal: The younger are in front, the elder behind.
translations.idiomatic: The younger are in front, the elder behind.

sentences.zh: 其還，則反之。

translations.literal: On the return, the order is reversed.
translations.idiomatic: On the return, the order is reversed.

sentences.zh: 長者持弓矢，短者持戈矛，力者持旌，勇者持鉦、鼓、刀、楯為前行，持矟者次之，弓箭者為後。

translations.literal: The tall hold bows and arrows, the short hold spears and halberds, the strong hold banners, the brave hold gongs, drums, swords, and shields in the vanguard; spear-bearers next; archers last.
translations.idiomatic: The tall hold bows and arrows, the short hold spears and halberds, the strong hold banners, the brave hold gongs, drums, swords, and shields in the vanguard; spear-bearers next; archers last.

sentences.zh: 使其習見旌旗、金鼓之節。

translations.literal: They are made to become familiar with the signals of banners and gongs and drums.
translations.idiomatic: They are made to become familiar with the signals of banners and gongs and drums.

sentences.zh: 旗臥則跪，旗舉則起。

translations.literal: When the flag lies, they kneel; when the flag rises, they stand.
translations.idiomatic: When the flag lies, they kneel; when the flag rises, they stand.

sentences.zh: 講武之日，未明十刻而嚴，五刻而甲，步軍為直陣以俟，大將立旗鼓之下。

translations.literal: On the day of the exercise, at the tenth quarter before dawn strictness is announced; at the fifth quarter they arm; infantry form a straight formation to wait; the great general stands below the drums and banners.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of the exercise, at the tenth quarter before dawn strictness is announced; at the fifth quarter they arm; infantry form a straight formation to wait; the great general stands below the drums and banners.

sentences.zh: 六軍各鼓十二、鉦一、大角四。

translations.literal: Each of the six armies has twelve drums, one gong, and four great horns.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the six armies has twelve drums, one gong, and four great horns.

sentences.zh: 未明七刻，鼓一嚴，侍中奏「開宮殿門及城門」。

translations.literal: At the seventh quarter before dawn, one strictness: the attendant within the palace reports "Open the palace and city gates."
translations.idiomatic: At the seventh quarter before dawn, one strictness: the palace attendant reports "Open the palace and city gates."

sentences.zh: 五刻，再嚴，侍中版奏「請中嚴」。

translations.literal: At the fifth quarter, a second strictness: the attendant within the palace memorializes on the placard: "I request inner vigilance."
translations.idiomatic: At the fifth quarter, a second strictness: the palace attendant memorializes on the placard: "I request inner vigilance."

sentences.zh: 文武官應從者俱先置，文武官皆公服，所司為小駕。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials who should follow are all placed first; civil and military officials all wear court dress; the responsible office prepares the small imperial escort.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials who should follow are all placed first; civil and military officials all wear court dress; the responsible office prepares the small imperial escort.

sentences.zh: 二刻，三嚴，諸衞各督其隊與鈒戟以次入，陳於殿庭。

translations.literal: At the second quarter, a third strictness: each guard supervises its company and halberds enter in order and are arrayed in the hall courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: At the second quarter, a third strictness: each guard supervises its company and halberds enter in order and are arrayed in the hall courtyard.

sentences.zh: 皇帝乘革輅至墠所，兵部尚書介冑乘馬奉引，入自北門，至兩步軍之北，南向。

translations.literal: The emperor rides the leather chariot to the platform; the minister of war in armor on horseback leads the way, entering from the north gate to north of the two infantry armies, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rides the leather chariot to the platform; the minister of war in armor on horseback leads the way, entering from the north gate to north of the two infantry armies, facing south.

sentences.zh: 黃門侍郎請降輅。

translations.literal: The attendant within the yellow gate requests that he descend the chariot.
translations.idiomatic: The attendant within the yellow gate requests that he descend the chariot.

sentences.zh: 乃入大次。

translations.literal: He then enters the great pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: He then enters the great pavilion.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書停於東廂，西向。

translations.literal: The minister of war stops in the east wing, facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The minister of war stops in the east wing, facing west.

sentences.zh: 領軍減小駕，騎士立於都墠之四周，侍臣左右立於大次之前，北上。

translations.literal: The commandant reduces the small escort; horsemen stand around the four sides of the platform; attendant ministers stand left and right before the great pavilion, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: The commandant reduces the small escort; horsemen stand around the four sides of the platform; attendant ministers stand left and right before the great pavilion, facing north.

sentences.zh: 九品以上皆公服，東、西在侍臣之外十步所，重行北上。

translations.literal: All of ninth rank and above wear court dress, east and west ten paces outside the attendant ministers, double ranks facing north.
translations.idiomatic: All of ninth rank and above wear court dress, east and west ten paces outside the attendant ministers, double ranks facing north.

sentences.zh: 諸州使人及蕃客先集於北門外，東方、南方立於道東，西方、北方立於道西，北上。

translations.literal: Envoys from the provinces and barbarian guests first assemble outside the north gate; east and south stand east of the road, west and north stand west of the road, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from the provinces and barbarian guests first assemble outside the north gate; east and south stand east of the road, west and north stand west of the road, facing north.

sentences.zh: 駕將至，奉禮曰：「再拜」。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage is about to arrive, the Director of Ritual says: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage is about to arrive, the Director of Ritual says: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 在位者皆再拜。

translations.literal: Those in place all twice bow.
translations.idiomatic: Those in place all bow twice.

sentences.zh: 皇帝入次，謁者引諸州使人，鴻臚引蕃客，東方、南方立於大次東北，西方、北方立於西北，觀者立於都墠騎士仗外四周，然後講武。

translations.literal: The emperor enters the pavilion; ushers lead envoys from the provinces; the Grand Master of Ceremonies for Foreign Guests leads barbarian guests—east and south stand northeast of the great pavilion, west and north stand northwest; spectators stand outside the horsemen's guards on all four sides—then the exercise begins.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor enters the pavilion; ushers lead envoys from the provinces; the Grand Master of Ceremonies for Foreign Guests leads barbarian guests—east and south stand northeast of the great pavilion, west and north stand northwest; spectators stand outside the horsemen's guards on all four sides—then the exercise begins.

sentences.zh: 吹大角三通。

translations.literal: The great horn is blown three times.
translations.idiomatic: The great horn is blown three times.

sentences.zh: 中軍將各以鞞令鼓，二軍俱擊鼓。

translations.literal: Each central-army general beats the leather drum with the command baton; both armies strike drums together.
translations.idiomatic: Each central-army general beats the leather drum with the command baton; both armies strike drums together.

sentences.zh: 三鼓，有司偃旗，步士皆跪。

translations.literal: Three drumbeats; the responsible officers lower the flags; infantrymen all kneel.
translations.idiomatic: Three drumbeats; the responsible officers lower the flags; infantrymen all kneel.

sentences.zh: 諸帥果毅以上，各集於其中軍。

translations.literal: Generals of guoyi rank and above each assemble at the central army.
translations.idiomatic: Generals of guoyi rank and above each assemble at the central army.

sentences.zh: 左廂中軍大將立於旗鼓之東，西面，諸軍將立於其南；

translations.literal: The left wing's central-army great general stands east of the drums and banners, facing west; military generals stand south of him;
translations.idiomatic: The left wing's central-army great general stands east of the drums and banners, facing west; military generals stand south of him;

sentences.zh: 右廂中軍大將立於旗鼓之西，東面，諸軍將立於其南。

translations.literal: the right wing's central-army great general stands west of the drums and banners, facing east; military generals stand south of him.
translations.idiomatic: the right wing's central-army great general stands west of the drums and banners, facing east; military generals stand south of him.

sentences.zh: 北面，以聽大將誓。

translations.literal: Facing north, they listen to the great general's oath.
translations.idiomatic: Facing north, they listen to the great general's oath.

sentences.zh: 左右三軍各長史二人，振鐸分循，諸果毅各以誓詞告其所部。

translations.literal: On left and right, each army has two adjutants who ring the bell and patrol separately; each guoyi announces the oath text to his unit.
translations.idiomatic: On left and right, each army has two adjutants who ring the bell and patrol separately; each guoyi announces the oath text to his unit.

sentences.zh: 遂聲鼓，有司舉旗，士眾皆起行，及表，擊鉦，乃止。

translations.literal: Then the drums sound; the responsible officers raise the flags; the troops all rise and march; reaching a marker, the gong is struck and they halt.
translations.idiomatic: Then the drums sound; the responsible officers raise the flags; the troops all rise and march; reaching a marker, the gong is struck and they halt.

sentences.zh: 又擊三鼓，有司偃旗，士眾皆跪。

translations.literal: Three drumbeats again; the responsible officers lower the flags; the troops all kneel.
translations.idiomatic: Three drumbeats again; the responsible officers lower the flags; the troops all kneel.

sentences.zh: 又擊鼓，有司舉旗，士眾皆起，驟及表，乃止。

translations.literal: Drums strike again; the responsible officers raise the flags; the troops all rise, rush to a marker, and halt.
translations.idiomatic: Drums strike again; the responsible officers raise the flags; the troops all rise, rush to a marker, and halt.

sentences.zh: 東軍一鼓，舉青旗為直陣；

translations.literal: The eastern army: one drumbeat; raise the azure flag as a straight formation;
translations.idiomatic: The eastern army: one drumbeat; raise the azure flag as a straight formation;

sentences.zh: 西軍亦鼓，舉白旗為方陣以應。

translations.literal: the western army also drums; raise the white flag as a square formation in response.
translations.idiomatic: the western army also drums; raise the white flag as a square formation in response.

sentences.zh: 次西軍鼓，舉赤旗為銳陣；

translations.literal: Next the western army drums; raise the crimson flag as a sharp formation;
translations.idiomatic: Next the western army drums; raise the crimson flag as a sharp formation;

sentences.zh: 東軍亦鼓，舉黑旗為曲陣以應。

translations.literal: the eastern army also drums; raise the black flag as a curved formation in response.
translations.idiomatic: the eastern army also drums; raise the black flag as a curved formation in response.

sentences.zh: 次東軍鼓，舉黃旗為圜陣；

translations.literal: Next the eastern army drums; raise the yellow flag as a circular formation;
translations.idiomatic: Next the eastern army drums; raise the yellow flag as a circular formation;

sentences.zh: 西軍亦鼓，舉青旗為直陣以應。

translations.literal: the western army also drums; raise the azure flag as a straight formation in response.
translations.idiomatic: the western army also drums; raise the azure flag as a straight formation in response.

sentences.zh: 次西軍鼓，舉白旗為方陣；

translations.literal: Next the western army drums; raise the white flag as a square formation;
translations.idiomatic: Next the western army drums; raise the white flag as a square formation;

sentences.zh: 東軍亦鼓，舉赤旗為銳陣以應。

translations.literal: the eastern army also drums; raise the crimson flag as a sharp formation in response.
translations.idiomatic: the eastern army also drums; raise the crimson flag as a sharp formation in response.

sentences.zh: 次東軍鼓，舉黑旗為曲陣；

translations.literal: Next the eastern army drums; raise the black flag as a curved formation;
translations.idiomatic: Next the eastern army drums; raise the black flag as a curved formation;

sentences.zh: 西軍亦鼓，舉黃旗為圜陣以應。

translations.literal: the western army also drums; raise the yellow flag as a circular formation in response.
translations.idiomatic: the western army also drums; raise the yellow flag as a circular formation in response.

sentences.zh: 凡陣，先舉者為客，後舉者為主。

translations.literal: In formations, whoever raises first is guest; whoever raises after is host.
translations.idiomatic: In formations, whoever raises first is guest; whoever raises after is host.

sentences.zh: 每變陣，二軍各選刀、楯五十人挑戰，第一、第二挑戰迭為勇怯之狀，第三挑戰為敵均之勢，第四、第五挑戰為勝敗之形。

translations.literal: At each formation change, each army selects fifty men with swords and shields to challenge; the first and second challenges alternate showing bold and timid; the third shows evenly matched foes; the fourth and fifth show victory and defeat.
translations.idiomatic: At each formation change, each army selects fifty men with swords and shields to challenge; the first and second challenges alternate showing bold and timid; the third shows evenly matched foes; the fourth and fifth show victory and defeat.

sentences.zh: 每將變陣，先鼓而直陣，然後變從餘陣之法。

translations.literal: Whenever about to change formation, drums first for the straight formation, then change according to the method for the remaining formations.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever about to change formation, drums first for the straight formation, then change according to the method for the remaining formations.

sentences.zh: 既已，兩軍俱為直陣。

translations.literal: When finished, both armies form straight formations.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, both armies form straight formations.

sentences.zh: 又擊三鼓，有司偃旗，士眾皆跪。

translations.literal: Three drumbeats again; the responsible officers lower the flags; the troops all kneel.
translations.idiomatic: Three drumbeats again; the responsible officers lower the flags; the troops all kneel.

sentences.zh: 又聲鼓舉旗，士眾皆起，騎馳、徒走，左右軍俱至中表，相擬擊而還。

translations.literal: Drums sound and flags rise again; the troops all rise; cavalry gallop and infantry run; both armies reach the central marker, feign attack, and return.
translations.idiomatic: Drums sound and flags rise again; the troops all rise; cavalry gallop and infantry run; both armies reach the central marker, feign attack, and return.

sentences.zh: 每退至一行表，跪起如前，遂復其初。

translations.literal: Each time they withdraw to one row of markers, kneel and rise as before, then return to the beginning.
translations.idiomatic: Each time they withdraw to one row of markers, kneel and rise as before, then return to the beginning.

sentences.zh: 侍中跪奏「請觀騎軍」，承制曰：「可。

translations.literal: The attendant within the palace kneels and reports: "I request to view the cavalry"; receives the command: "It is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The palace attendant kneels and reports: "I request to view the cavalry"; receives the command: "It is permitted.

sentences.zh: 」二軍騎軍皆如步軍之法，每陣各八騎挑戰，五陣畢，大擊鼓而前，盤馬相擬擊而罷。

translations.literal: " Both armies' cavalry follow the infantry method; each formation has eight horsemen challenge; after five formations, great drums beat and they advance; wheeling horses they feign attack and stop.
translations.idiomatic: " Both armies' cavalry follow the infantry method; each formation has eight horsemen challenge; after five formations, great drums beat and they advance; wheeling horses they feign attack and stop.

sentences.zh: 遂振旅。

translations.literal: They then dismiss the troops.
translations.idiomatic: They then dismiss the troops.

sentences.zh: 侍中跪奏稱：「侍中臣某言，禮畢。

translations.literal: The attendant within the palace kneels and reports: "The attendant within the palace, your subject So-and-so, reports: the rite is complete.
translations.idiomatic: The palace attendant kneels and reports: "The palace attendant, your subject So-and-so, reports: the rite is complete.

sentences.zh: 」乃還。

translations.literal: " He then returns.
translations.idiomatic: " He then returns.

sentences.zh: 皇帝狩田之禮，亦以仲冬。

translations.literal: The emperor's hunting rite is also in mid-winter.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's hunting rite is also in mid-winter.

sentences.zh: 前期，兵部集眾庶脩田法，虞部表所田之野，建旗於其後。

translations.literal: In advance, the Ministry of War assembles the common people to practice field law; the Department of Parks memorializes the chosen field; a flag is raised behind it.
translations.idiomatic: In advance, the Ministry of War assembles the common people to practice field law; the Department of Parks memorializes the chosen field; a flag is raised behind it.

sentences.zh: 前一日，諸將帥士集於旗下。

translations.literal: On the day before, generals and soldiers assemble beneath the flag.
translations.idiomatic: On the day before, generals and soldiers assemble beneath the flag.

sentences.zh: 質明，弊旗，後至者罰。

translations.literal: At dawn the flag is lowered; latecomers are punished.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the flag is lowered; latecomers are punished.

sentences.zh: 兵部申田令，遂圍田。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War announces field orders and the field is enclosed.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War announces field orders and the field is enclosed.

sentences.zh: 其兩翼之將皆建旗。

translations.literal: The wing generals all raise flags.
translations.idiomatic: The wing generals all raise flags.

sentences.zh: 及夜，布圍，闕其南面。

translations.literal: By night the enclosure is laid out, leaving the south open.
translations.idiomatic: By night the enclosure is laid out, leaving the south open.

sentences.zh: 駕至田所，皇帝鼓行入圍，鼓吹令以鼓六十陳於皇帝東南，西向；

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage reaches the field, the emperor beats drums and enters the enclosure; the Director of Court Music arrays sixty drums southeast of the emperor, facing west;
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage reaches the field, the emperor beats drums and enters the enclosure; the Director of Court Music arrays sixty drums southeast of the emperor, facing west;

sentences.zh: 六十陳於西南，東向。

translations.literal: sixty arrayed southwest, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: sixty arrayed southwest, facing east.

sentences.zh: 皆乘馬，各備簫角。

translations.literal: All mount horses, each with pipes and horns.
translations.idiomatic: All mount horses, each with pipes and horns.

sentences.zh: 諸將皆鼓行圍。

translations.literal: All generals beat drums and encircle the field.
translations.idiomatic: All generals beat drums and encircle the field.

sentences.zh: 乃設驅逆之騎。

translations.literal: Driving-off cavalry is then set.
translations.idiomatic: Driving-off cavalry is then set.

sentences.zh: 皇帝乘馬南向，有司斂大綏以從。

translations.literal: The emperor mounts a horse facing south; the responsible office gathers the great feathered banners to follow.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor mounts a horse facing south; the responsible office gathers the great feathered banners to follow.

sentences.zh: 諸公、王以下皆乘馬，帶弓矢，陳於前後。

translations.literal: Dukes, kings, and those below all mount horses, bearing bows and arrows, arrayed before and behind.
translations.idiomatic: Dukes, kings, and those below all mount horses, bearing bows and arrows, arrayed before and behind.

sentences.zh: 所司之屬又斂小綏以從。

translations.literal: Subordinates of the responsible office also gather the small feathered banners to follow.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinates of the responsible office also gather the small feathered banners to follow.

sentences.zh: 乃驅獸出前。

translations.literal: Beasts are then driven out ahead.
translations.idiomatic: Beasts are then driven out ahead.

sentences.zh: 初，一驅過，有司整飭弓矢以前。

translations.literal: At first, after one drive passes, the responsible office arranges bows and arrows forward.
translations.idiomatic: At first, after one drive passes, the responsible office arranges bows and arrows forward.

sentences.zh: 再驅過，有司奉進弓矢。

translations.literal: After a second drive, the responsible office advances bows and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: After a second drive, the responsible office advances bows and arrows.

sentences.zh: 三驅過，皇帝乃從禽左而射之。

translations.literal: After a third drive, the emperor shoots from the left of the game.
translations.idiomatic: After a third drive, the emperor shoots from the left of the game.

sentences.zh: 每驅必三獸以上。

translations.literal: Each drive must have three beasts or more.
translations.idiomatic: Each drive must have three beasts or more.

sentences.zh: 皇帝發，抗大綏，然後公、王發，抗小綏。

translations.literal: When the emperor shoots, he raises the great feathered banner; then dukes and kings shoot, raising the small feathered banners.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor shoots, he raises the great feathered banner; then dukes and kings shoot, raising the small feathered banners.

sentences.zh: 驅逆之騎止，然後百姓獵。

translations.literal: When the driving-off cavalry stops, the common people hunt.
translations.idiomatic: When the driving-off cavalry stops, the common people hunt.

sentences.zh: 凡射獸，自左而射之，達於右腢為上射，達右耳本為次射，左髀達於右䯚為下射。

translations.literal: In shooting beasts, shoot from the left; reaching the right haunch is superior shooting; reaching the base of the right ear is second; left thigh reaching the right knee is inferior shooting.
translations.idiomatic: In shooting beasts, shoot from the left; reaching the right haunch is superior shooting; reaching the base of the right ear is second; left thigh reaching the right knee is inferior shooting.

sentences.zh: 羣獸相從不盡殺，已被射者不重射。

translations.literal: When beasts run together, do not kill all; those already shot are not shot again.
translations.idiomatic: When beasts run together, do not kill all; those already shot are not shot again.

sentences.zh: 不射其面，不翦其毛。

translations.literal: Do not shoot the face; do not cut the fur.
translations.idiomatic: Do not shoot the face; do not cut the fur.

sentences.zh: 凡出表者不逐之。

translations.literal: Whatever goes beyond the markers is not pursued.
translations.idiomatic: Whatever goes beyond the markers is not pursued.

sentences.zh: 田將止，虞部建旗於田內，乃雷擊駕鼓及諸將之鼓，士從躁呼。

translations.literal: When the field is about to end, the Department of Parks raises a flag within the field; then thunderously strike the imperial carriage drum and the generals' drums; soldiers follow with clamorous shouts.
translations.idiomatic: When the field is about to end, the Department of Parks raises a flag within the field; then thunderously strike the imperial carriage drum and the generals' drums; soldiers follow with clamorous shouts.

sentences.zh: 諸得禽獻旗下，致其左耳。

translations.literal: All who obtain game present it beneath the flag, offering the left ear.
translations.idiomatic: All who obtain game present it beneath the flag, offering the left ear.

sentences.zh: 大獸公之，小獸私之。

translations.literal: Large game is public; small game is private.
translations.idiomatic: Large game is public; small game is private.

sentences.zh: 其上者供宗廟，次者供賓客，下者充庖廚。

translations.literal: The best supplies the ancestral temple, the next supplies guests, the lowest fills the kitchens.
translations.idiomatic: The best supplies the ancestral temple, the next supplies guests, the lowest fills the kitchens.

sentences.zh: 乃命有司饁獸於四郊，以獸告至於廟社。

translations.literal: The responsible office is then ordered to distribute game in the four suburbs and announce the beasts' arrival at the temple and altars.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible office is then ordered to distribute game in the four suburbs and announce the beasts' arrival at the temple and altars.

sentences.zh: 射。

translations.literal: Archery.
translations.idiomatic: Archery.

sentences.zh: 前一日，太樂令設宮縣之樂，鼓吹令設十二桉於射殿之庭，東面縣在東階東，西面縣在西階西。

translations.literal: On the day before, the Director of Imperial Music sets the palace bell music; the Director of Court Music sets twelve music stands in the archery hall courtyard—eastern set east of the east steps, western set west of the west steps.
translations.idiomatic: On the day before, the Director of Imperial Music sets the palace bell music; the Director of Court Music sets twelve music stands in the archery hall courtyard—eastern set east of the east steps, western set west of the west steps.

sentences.zh: 南北二縣及登歌廣開中央，避射位。

translations.literal: The northern and southern sets and elevated singers open wide in the center, avoiding the shooting positions.
translations.idiomatic: The northern and southern sets and elevated singers open wide in the center, avoiding the shooting positions.

sentences.zh: 張熊侯去殿九十步，設乏於侯西十步、北十步。

translations.literal: A bear target is set ninety paces from the hall; a marker of exhaustion is set ten paces west and ten paces north of the target.
translations.idiomatic: A bear target is set ninety paces from the hall; a marker of exhaustion is set ten paces west and ten paces north of the target.

sentences.zh: 設五楅庭前，少西。

translations.literal: Five arrow-holders are set before the courtyard, slightly west.
translations.idiomatic: Five arrow-holders are set before the courtyard, slightly west.

sentences.zh: 布侍射者位於西階前，東面北上。

translations.literal: Positions for attendant archers are laid before the west steps, facing east with the north uppermost.
translations.idiomatic: Positions for attendant archers are laid before the west steps, facing east with the north uppermost.

sentences.zh: 布司馬位於侍射位之南，東面。

translations.literal: The Master of Horse position is south of the attendant archers' place, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The Master of Horse position is south of the attendant archers' place, facing east.

sentences.zh: 布獲者位乏東，東面。

translations.literal: The marker-holder's place is east of the exhaustion marker, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: The marker-holder's place is east of the exhaustion marker, facing east.

sentences.zh: 布侍射者射位於殿階下，當前少西，橫布，南面。

translations.literal: Attendant archers' shooting places are below the hall steps, slightly west of center, laid crosswise, facing south.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant archers' shooting places are below the hall steps, slightly west of center, laid crosswise, facing south.

sentences.zh: 侍射者弓矢俟於西門外。

translations.literal: Attendant archers' bows and arrows wait outside the west gate.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant archers' bows and arrows wait outside the west gate.

sentences.zh: 陳賞物於東階下，少東。

translations.literal: Rewards are displayed below the east steps, slightly east.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards are displayed below the east steps, slightly east.

sentences.zh: 置罰豐於西階下，少西。

translations.literal: A penalty mound is placed below the west steps, slightly west.
translations.idiomatic: A penalty mound is placed below the west steps, slightly west.

sentences.zh: 設罰尊於西階，南北以殿深。

translations.literal: A penalty vessel is set at the west steps, north-south according to the hall's depth.
translations.idiomatic: A penalty vessel is set at the west steps, north-south according to the hall's depth.

sentences.zh: 設篚於尊西，南肆，實爵加冪。

translations.literal: Baskets are set west of the vessel, displayed to the south, filled with goblets under cover.
translations.idiomatic: Baskets are set west of the vessel, displayed to the south, filled with goblets under cover.

sentences.zh: 其日質明，皇帝服武弁，文武官俱公服，典謁引入見，樂作，如元會之儀。

translations.literal: At dawn that day the emperor wears the military cap; civil and military officials all wear court dress; the Director of Audience leads them in to audience; music plays, as in the great assembly rite.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn that day the emperor wears the military cap; civil and military officials all wear court dress; the Director of Audience leads them in to audience; music plays, as in the great assembly rite.

sentences.zh: 酒二徧，侍中一人奏稱：「有司謹具，請射。

translations.literal: After two rounds of wine, one attendant within the palace reports: "The responsible office respectfully reports all is ready; I request archery.
translations.idiomatic: After two rounds of wine, one palace attendant reports: "The responsible office respectfully reports all is ready; I request archery.

sentences.zh: 」侍中一人前承制，退稱：「制曰可。

translations.literal: " One attendant within the palace advances to receive the command, withdraws, and says: "The command is: permitted.
translations.idiomatic: " One palace attendant advances to receive the command, withdraws, and says: "The command is: permitted.

sentences.zh: 」王、公以下皆降。

translations.literal: " Kings, dukes, and those below all descend.
translations.idiomatic: " Kings, dukes, and those below all descend.

sentences.zh: 文官立於東階下，西面北上。

translations.literal: Civil officials stand below the east steps, facing west with the north uppermost.
translations.idiomatic: Civil officials stand below the east steps, facing west with the north uppermost.

sentences.zh: 武官立於西階下，於射乏後，東面北上。

translations.literal: Military officials stand below the west steps, behind the archery exhaustion marker, facing east with the north uppermost.
translations.idiomatic: Military officials stand below the west steps, behind the archery exhaustion marker, facing east with the north uppermost.

sentences.zh: 持鈒隊羣立於兩邊，千牛備身二人奉御弓及矢立於東階上，西面，執弓者在北。

translations.literal: Halberd-bearing companies stand on both sides; two Imperial Ox bodyguards hold the imperial bow and arrows on the east steps, facing west, bow-bearer to the north.
translations.idiomatic: Halberd-bearing companies stand on both sides; two Imperial Ox bodyguards hold the imperial bow and arrows on the east steps, facing west, bow-bearer to the north.

sentences.zh: 又設坫於執弓者之前，又置御決、拾笥於其上。

translations.literal: An altar is also set before the bow-bearer; imperial thumb-ring, armguard, and quiver are placed on it.
translations.idiomatic: An altar is also set before the bow-bearer; imperial thumb-ring, armguard, and quiver are placed on it.

sentences.zh: 獲者持旌自乏南行，當侯東，行至侯，負侯北面立。

translations.literal: The marker-holder carries a banner south from the exhaustion marker, east of the target, walks to the target, faces north with the target on his back, and stands.
translations.idiomatic: The marker-holder carries a banner south from the exhaustion marker, east of the target, walks to the target, faces north with the target on his back, and stands.

sentences.zh: 侍射者出西門外，取弓矢，兩手奉弓，搢乘矢帶，入，立於殿下射位西，東面。

translations.literal: Attendant archers go out the west gate, take bows and arrows, hold the bow with both hands, insert the arrow in the belt, enter, and stand west of the shooting place below the hall, facing east.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant archers go out the west gate, take bows and arrows, hold the bow with both hands, insert the arrow in the belt, enter, and stand west of the shooting place below the hall, facing east.

sentences.zh: 司馬奉弓自西階升，當西楹前，南面，揮弓，命獲者以旌去侯西行十步，北行至乏止。
